places.name: Baga Beach
places.desc: Popular beach known for water sports, beach shacks and lively nightlife along the shore.

places.name: Calangute Beach
places.desc: Goa's largest beach, buzzing with markets and family-friendly stretches of sand.

places.name: Fort Aguada
places.desc: 17th-century Portuguese fort with a lighthouse and sweeping sea views, popular at sunset.

places.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
places.desc: UNESCO World Heritage church holding the relics of St. Francis Xavier.

places.name: Dudhsagar Falls
places.desc: One of India's tallest waterfalls, reached via a jungle jeep safari through a wildlife sanctuary.

places.name: Anjuna Flea Market
places.desc: Famous flea market for handicrafts, clothes and live music right by the beach.

places.name: Chapora Fort
places.desc: Hilltop fort overlooking the Chapora river, made famous by a popular Bollywood film.

places.name: Se Cathedral
places.desc: One of Asia's largest churches, known for its Golden Bell and colonial architecture.

places.name: Palolem Beach
places.desc: A calmer, crescent-shaped beach in South Goa known for silent parties and dolphin trips.

places.name: Mandovi River Casino Cruise
places.desc: Floating casinos on the Mandovi river offering gaming, dinner and live entertainment.

places.name: Solang Valley
places.desc: Adventure hub for paragliding, zorbing and skiing, framed by snow-capped peaks.

places.name: Rohtang Pass
places.desc: High-altitude mountain pass with snow activities; needs an entry permit.

places.name: Hadimba Temple
places.desc: A wooden cave temple set inside a cedar forest, dedicated to Hidimba Devi.

places.name: Old Manali
places.desc: A laid-back village across the river known for cafes, live music and boutique shopping.

places.name: Manikaran Sahib
places.desc: A Sikh-Hindu pilgrimage site famous for its natural hot springs and free community kitchen.

places.name: Vashisht Hot Springs
places.desc: Natural sulfur hot water springs beside an ancient temple, popular for a relaxing soak.

places.name: Jogini Waterfall
places.desc: A scenic waterfall reached via a moderate hike from Vashisht village.

places.name: Mall Road
places.desc: Manali's main pedestrian street lined with shops, cafes and street food stalls.

places.name: Beas River Rafting
places.desc: River rafting stretch along the Beas River, popular for a half-day adventure.

places.name: Kasol
places.desc: A riverside village near Manali known for trekking trails and scenic campsites.
